i_cliff: A GREEN CLIFF-TOP PLATEAU ON A SUNNY ISLAND above WHITE CHALK CLIFFS that drop sheer into a deep blue sea along the north and west, white surf at their foot; fresh green turf, patches of wind-bent grass with pink sea thrift and white daisies; groups of dark wind-bent sea pines; on a headland reaching into the sea in the north the roofless ruin of a round white watchtower; a pale road of packed earth and crushed shell comes over an old arched white stone bridge across a deep ravine in the south-west and runs north and then east across the plateau; a footpath to the tower. Palette: vivid grass greens, chalk white and pale grey, deep ultramarine and turquoise sea. Breezy, bright, open.
i_cove: A HIDDEN COVE ON A SUNNY ISLAND: in the south a wide crescent BEACH of fine WHITE SAND around a bay of clear turquoise shallows turning deep blue further out, lines of white foam; low WHITE CLIFFS arc behind the beach with a narrow gully where a footpath comes down; on the cliff top in the north green meadow, pines and the main road running west to east; at the foot of the eastern cliff the dark jagged mouth of a SEA CAVE; reefs of dark rock in the shallows, small tide pools on the sand, a few coconut palms. Palette: white sand, turquoise and deep blue water, chalk white, fresh greens. Paradise-like, calm, a little mysterious.
i_cape: THE NECK OF A LONG CAPE ON A SUNNY ISLAND: a narrow ridge of green meadow runs from the south-west to the north between two deep blue seas, its edges ringed by white rocks and surf; wind-bent grass with pink sea thrift and white flowers, a few dark pines and bushes; small cairns of piled white stones; an old wooden signal mast with a crossed yard on a heap of stones; a pale road winds along the top of the ridge from the west edge to the north edge where a village lies. Palette: greens, chalk white, deep blue and turquoise sea. Windswept, lonely, beautiful.
i_light: A SMALL ROCKY ISLAND IN THE OPEN SEA, dominated by its LIGHTHOUSE: short green turf, wind-bent grass and sea pinks over grey rock; a ring of dark wet rock shelves and boulders all around the shore with white surf breaking on them; a little crescent of white sand in the west cove; on the flat rock crag in the north stands a TALL ROUND LIGHTHOUSE of whitewashed stone with two faded red bands, an iron gallery and a dark glass lamp room with a domed roof, a small arched door facing south onto a little yard of pale flagstones; east of it the roofless ruin of the keeper's cottage; a winding footpath climbs from a simple wooden jetty on the south shore; a small tide pool; a few wind-bent sea pines. Deep blue sea with a turquoise rim of shallows. Palette: white, faded red, fresh greens, slate grey, deep blue. Lonely and abandoned, but beautiful.
i_siren: A SMALL ISLET IN THE OPEN SEA with ONE STRIKING LANDMARK: in its middle rises the SINGING ROCK, a tall sculpted sea stack of dark slate-grey stone pierced by round wind holes and a narrow arch, shells, pale coral and mother-of-pearl at its foot; around it dark wet rock shelves with tide pools and barnacles, patches of green turf and sea pinks in the north, a bright crescent of white sand beach in the south; a footpath from a wooden jetty on the east shore leads to the foot of the rock; deep blue sea with turquoise shallows and white surf. Palette: slate greys, white sand, turquoise, deep blue, touches of pink and pearl. Eerie, windy, magical.
i_crab: A SANDY TROPICAL ISLET: bright WHITE SAND with a few patches of grass, coconut palms, a small turquoise lagoon; in the middle a big glittering MOUND of seashells, old gold coins and coral (a giant hermit crab's nest); a wooden jetty on the west; ringed by turquoise shallows and deep blue sea. Palette: white sand, palm greens, turquoise, gold. Sunny and playful.
i_wreck: A REEF IN THE OPEN SEA WITH A WRECKED MERCHANT SHIP: dark wet rock shelves and a long bar of white sand; run aground across the reef lies a BIG two-masted wooden MERCHANT SHIP heeled over, its hull holed and cargo spilling out, torn sails hanging from broken yards; on the sand south of it broken crates, barrels and a fallen mast; rocks in the surf; a simple wooden jetty on the south for a boat; deep blue sea all around with turquoise shallows. Palette: white sand, dark rock, weathered brown wood, off-white canvas, deep blue. Dramatic, a place of misfortune.
coral: A BRIGHT WHITE HARBOUR TOWN BUILT ON TERRACES DOWN A SEA CLIFF: whitewashed cube houses with flat roofs, blue doors, blue shutters and a few blue domes stand on three broad terraces held up by tall white retaining walls; long flights of white stone steps go down the walls; each terrace has a paved white walk along it and small green gardens with potted palms and bushes; a straight main street of white paving runs from an old stone bridge in the cliffs at the top down through all terraces to the harbour; at the bottom a wide paved QUAY with a timber shipyard shed and its wooden slipway on the west, a long stretch of the lowest terrace wall covered in carved names (the widows' wall), two wooden piers into the deep blue harbour water (one ends in a T), the tops of two broken masts of sunken warships sticking out of the water; white chalk cliffs frame the town on both sides. Palette: dazzling whites, sky and cobalt blues, fresh greens, warm wood, deep blue sea. Sunny, proud, a little sad.
nerei: A SMALL FISHING VILLAGE ON THE THIN RIDGE OF A CAPE in a dark blue sea: a narrow strip of green land ringed by white rocks; a trodden footpath runs along the middle of the ridge from the south to a little paved green at the very tip, where a stone lamp housing stands on a white pillar; small whitewashed cottages with blue doors and drying fishing nets stand in one row on either side of the path; two tiny white-sand coves on the shore; a long wooden pier on posts reaches out into the sea from the east side near the tip, ending in a T. Palette: whites, blues, greens, weathered wood, deep sea blue. Quiet, windswept, homely.
isles_cave_1: THE FIRST FLOOR OF A SEA CAVE, seen from above: winding passages of flat wet dark-grey rock shelves with barnacles, shells and patches of wet sand; channels and pools of dark teal sea water speckled with glowing plankton cross the passages; a round entrance hall in the south opening to the outside at the bottom; a central grotto with a pool and a barnacled standing stone carved with waves and a moon; a west grotto and an east grotto; a passage north to a shelf. Palette: slate and blue-black rock, teal and turquoise water, pale sand, white barnacles, green weed. Echoing, damp, mysterious.
isles_cave_2: THE DEEP FLOOR OF A SEA CAVE, seen from above: a great grotto around a large deep POOL of dark teal sea water glowing faintly with plankton; a ledge of flat wet dark rock runs round the pool on the west and east sides from a landing in the south up to a wide chamber in the north; beyond the chamber a small raised shelf of pale sand at the very north; patches of wet sand, shells, heaps of pebbles. Palette: blue-black rock, glowing teal water, pale sand, white barnacles. Awe, danger, stillness.
ghost_ship_1: THE UPPER DECK OF A HUGE DERELICT GHOST SHIP (a three-masted sailing ship) adrift in a foggy night sea, seen from above: it must read at first glance as the deck of a SHIP, not a pier or a dock. A long, gracefully curved wooden hull with a pointed bow to the east and a rounded stern to the west; a continuous raised BULWARK (the ship's side wall with a wooden rail on top and a row of stanchions) runs all around the deck edge, and the outside of the hull curves down into the water with a shadow on the sea; the deck planks run lengthwise (east-west) in long narrow rows with visible seams and dark tar lines, old, grey-brown, damp and rotting in places, a few holes and loose boards; a raised STERN DECK at the west behind a low railing with two short flights of steps, with the ship's wheel and the cracked skylight of the captain's cabin; a small raised BOW DECK at the east behind a railing with steps and a capstan; three thick broken mast stumps wrapped in rotten rigging and torn grey sails, ropes running from them to the bulwarks; an open hatch with a ladder down; a closed cargo hatch grating; a fallen yard with a torn sail on the deck; coils of rope, belaying pins, a broken bucket, scattered planks; a wide gangplank from the south bulwark over the water. Around the ship: a dark, cold sea with pale DRIFTS OF FOG and mist lying on the water all around the hull (fog on the water only, the deck stays clear). Palette: grey-browns, weathered greys, bone white sails, dark teal-blue sea, pale grey fog. Eerie, silent, cold.
ghost_ship_2: THE LOWER DECK OF A DERELICT GHOST SHIP, seen from above: a long central corridor of old wooden planks from a ladder in the west to steps down in the east; on both sides small crew cabins divided by wooden bulkheads, each with a door opening onto the corridor: torn hammocks, sea chests, a table with a lantern, broken bunks, a galley with water barrels; a corner flooded with sea water; the curved hull timbers around. Palette: dark browns, grey-green damp wood, dim teal water. Cramped, eerie, abandoned.
ghost_ship_3: THE HOLD AND THE CAPTAIN'S CABIN OF A DERELICT GHOST SHIP, seen from above: the big dark hold with ribs of the hull, stacks of broken crates and barrels of cargo, sea water flooding in through holes in the hull; steps up at the east; at the stern (west) behind a wooden bulkhead with one doorway the captain's cabin: a faded red carpet, a dark wooden chart table with an open logbook, a brass compass and rolled charts, leaded stern windows. Palette: very dark browns, faded crimson, brass, teal water. Oppressive, sad, final.

_extra.i_light: IMPORTANT: the LIGHTHOUSE is the hero of this map and must be unmistakable: a tall white cylindrical tower (drawn on its whole block, taller than wide) with two red bands, a black railed gallery and a glass lamp room with a dark domed cap at the top of the block, its round shadowed side and stone texture visible, the arched door at the bottom. The coastline is a NATURAL, IRREGULAR rocky shore with small coves and points, never polygonal, never stepped, no straight edges. Rich detail: rock pools, barnacles, grass tufts, wildflowers, pebbles, sea spray.
_extra.i_siren: IMPORTANT: the SINGING ROCK is the hero of this map and must be unmistakable and beautiful: a tall organic stone pillar (drawn on its whole block, taller than wide), curved and smooth like wind-worn sculpture, with several round holes through it and one arch, light and shadow modelling its round form, a ring of shells and coral at its base; not a cube, not a square block. The coastline is a NATURAL, IRREGULAR shore with small coves and points, never polygonal, never stepped, no straight edges. Rich detail: tide pools, barnacles, shells, starfish, sea pinks, foam.
_extra.i_wreck: IMPORTANT: the WRECK is the hero of this map and must be unmistakably a SHIP: a real wooden sailing ship hull (drawn on its whole block) with a clear curved outline, a pointed bow to the east, planked deck, hatches, two masts (one snapped), yards, rigging lines, torn sails, a gaping hole in its side; it is tilted, run aground, not a building and not a flat brown shape. The coastline is a NATURAL, IRREGULAR reef shore with small coves and points, never polygonal, never stepped, no straight edges. Rich detail: spilled crates and barrels, ropes, seaweed, shells, surf on the rocks.
_extra.ghost_ship_1: IMPORTANT SHIP SHAPE: the hull is a real sailing ship seen from above: the bow is ONE smooth, gracefully curved point (like a leaf tip), the bulwarks follow smooth continuous curves, the stern is rounded; NEVER a stepped, staircase or blocky outline anywhere, no right-angle notches in the hull. The guide's stepped bow is only a rough placement: smooth it within the tolerance. The ship's side (bulwark) must be clearly visible as a raised wooden wall with a rail along the whole deck edge (it is the thin dark-brown border of the guide), so the deck clearly sits INSIDE a ship. No lanterns (they are added later as sprites).
